correctness.rationale: Complete symbolic reconstruction from Ardila--Escobar marked-permutation vertices. The conditional relative-rank moments give v_n and c_n; constant coordinate sums and label symmetry give all covariance entries and eigenvectors. Strict positivity follows from the known full affine dimension. Exact c_n sign through n=9 plus a proven monotonicity for all n>=6 establishes the unique axis transition. Harmonic-number expansion proves the precise asymptotic. Python exact independent enumeration checks 34,152 vertices for n=2..5, all covariance entries, plus 299 rational profiles.

value.rationale: Complete spectral invariant and all eigendirections of a natural (2n-2)-dimensional polytope family, with a sharp and unexpected nine-label dominant-axis transition. The absolute spectral gap grows like n/(2 log n), but relative anisotropy disappears at sharp rate 6/(n log n). The precise correlated-permutation feature is not encoded by the existing shell or facial invariants.
